newsitem.title: UK: Euro veg oils mixed, traders cautious on Chicago.
newsitem.headline: Euro veg oils mixed, traders cautious on Chicago.

text.p: Closing European vegetable oil prices were mixed on Tuesday with traders cautious ahead of the Chicago close later in the evening.
As expected the USDA's crop report was bearish for soybeans with 1996 production put at 2.403 billion bushels against trade estimates of 2.376 billion.
However, the USDA later released data which put soybean export inspections for the week ended November 7 at 33.340 million bushels.
Traders said the export data was on the high side and could start to turn the Chicago market towards the close.
"I don't think Chicago will close up on Monday's close but prices won't be as low as they were at the opening," said a trader.
At the close Dutch soyoil was 2.50 to 1.50 guilders down after Feb/Apr traded at 87.50 guilders a 100 kilos fob ex-mill.
Rape oil finished 1.25 to one guilders down after Feb/Apr traded at 93.50, 93 and 92.25 guilders a 100 kilos.
Based on sellers' prices the premium for rape oil over soy oil was five to 5.50 guilders at the close against 4.50 to 5.25 guilders on Monday.
Crude palm oil closed $5 up to $5 down after Nov traded at $497.50 and Dec at $495 a tonne.
Refined palm oils finished unchanged to $5 higher.
Coconut oil closed mixed at $5 up to $5 down after Nov/Dec traded at $780, $757 and $770, Dec/Jan at $755 and $750 and Jan/Mar at $745 a tonne cif.
Traders said most of the business had been switching.
Palmkernel oil finished unchanged and tradeless.
